description: Exterior view of the Ghost Ranch house, screen door, cracked adobe wall, vigas, large wooden shelf, assortment of animal bones and horns; closeup view of portale wall of house with screen door and wooden plank shelf with an arrangement of  pelvis bones, rams horns, elk antlers, etc., leaning against the cracked adobe wall, natural light illuminates a portion of the wall and bones.
title: Recuerdos (Memories)
